newsitem.title: USA: Maine outages down to 2,500 customers after storm.
newsitem.headline: Maine outages down to 2,500 customers after storm.

text.p: Central Maine Power has restored power to all but about 2,500 customers by midday Monday and hoped to have everyone restored by nightfall, company officials said.

The utilty said many of the remaining problems are in the rural Sebago Lake region and in the Lewiston-area. Extra repair crews were brought in Monday from New Brunswick, Canada, according to officials.
The utility had about 61,000 customers without electricity has the height of the storm Saturday evening. The storm dropped up to 14 inches of heavy, wet snow on parts of CMP's service area.
